name: Contextsling
description: Connect your own contextsling.com account and publish one small Markdown file only after exact inline manual approval. Anyone with the link can read it; copies cannot be recalled.

permissions.label: Read your Contextsling documents
permissions.description: Read your own account, pinned revisions, manifests and usage through contextsling.com, the third-party recipient. No Agent Village context namespace access.

permissions.label: Review each public document action
permissions.description: Explicitly stage one small Markdown file for manual publish/update/revoke. Anyone holding its document link can read it. Inline card text remains in your box approval log even when declined; connecting alone does not approve publication.
